justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/output/NullWriter.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/output/NullWriterTest.java. NullWriter is a 180-line class with no instance state, one constructor, and 8 overriding methods plus 2 singleton fields; every method is a trivial no-op or simple argument-validation wrapper around IOUtils.checkFromToIndex/checkFromIndexSize. The test class only exercises this single null-sink behavior. This is a small, single-responsibility utility, not a class with multiple separable concerns or enough complexity to indicate insufficient modularization.
